claims.scope: Post-graduation token transfer triggers unstaking and reward distribution in the launchpad rewards system

preconditions.text: Users have earned fees during bonding that are held for distribution by the rewards system.; The token has graduated.; A user transfers tokens after graduation, which triggers unstaking.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.
evidence: The launchpad rewards system distributes earned fees to users when they unbond or claim. However, after token graduation, when users transfer tokens (triggering unstaking), the rewards are incorrectly sent to the launchpad contract instead of the user.
Users cannot receive rewards earned during bonding when transferring tokens after graduation, leading to loss of funds.

In `LaunchToken._decreaseFeeShares()`, token transfers post-graduation call `launchpad.decreaseStake(account, amount)`, which invokes `Distributor.decreaseStake()`. This function unstakes the user and calls `_distributeAssets()` to transfer rewards, but `_distributeAssets()` sends tokens to `msg.sender`, which is the launchpad (as `decreaseStake()` is restricted to `onlyLaunchpad`).

safety.text: When a user's tokens are unstaked on transfer after graduation, the rewards earned during bonding should be distributed to that user, not to the launchpad contract.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

> `claimRewards()` correctly sends to `msg.sender`, but automatic unstaking on transfer does not.
